lab_meeting.rhetorical_emphasis: Data-centric, iterative, invites critique and discussion from peers
lab_meeting.key_defaults_text: 12-minute lab meeting format. Focus on new results and open questions. Minimal background; colleagues know the field.

conference_talk.rhetorical_emphasis: Broad accessibility, narrative arc from problem to solution, compelling visuals
conference_talk.key_defaults_text: 15-minute conference talk. Accessible to a broad audience. Strong narrative: problem, approach, results, impact.

seminar.rhetorical_emphasis: Depth and rigor, comprehensive methods, pedagogical clarity
seminar.key_defaults_text: 45-minute seminar. Deep technical content acceptable. Include comprehensive background and methods sections.

lecture.rhetorical_emphasis: Pedagogical clarity, stepwise concept building, student engagement
lecture.key_defaults_text: 60-minute lecture. Teach from first principles. Build concepts progressively. Include worked examples.

journal_club.rhetorical_emphasis: Critical appraisal, figure-by-figure analysis, strengths and limitations
journal_club.key_defaults_text: 20-minute journal club. Walk through a paper figure by figure. Highlight methods, statistics, and interpretation.

grant_panel.rhetorical_emphasis: Significance, innovation, feasibility; persuasive and concise
grant_panel.key_defaults_text: 12-minute grant panel. Lead with significance. Demonstrate feasibility with preliminary data. Emphasize innovation.

job_talk.rhetorical_emphasis: Showcase scientific identity, breadth and depth, future vision
job_talk.key_defaults_text: 45-minute job talk. Tell a coherent scientific story. Show past work, current results, and future directions.

custom.key_defaults_text: Custom presentation format. All defaults are user-configurable. Specify duration, audience, and goals during briefing.
